svg.text: React Native (Expo SDK 58, New Architecture, Hermes): layered, feature-oriented
Screens · Expo Router (file-based, typed routes, auth-guarded stacks)
Feature modules (hooks own the logic; screens stay presentational)
24 h cache of searches & stores, keyed by
Platform services (Expo modules, all in Expo Go)
OWASP MASVS: no secrets in bundle,
Dependencies point downwards only. Screens never call fetch directly; features never touch platform APIs except through small adapters, so each layer is unit-testable.
